title: Electric Gold
style: English, upbeat synth-pop, bright male voice, punchy synth bass, neon pads, driving beat, 116 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
City lights are calling out my name
Midnight streets all look the same
I keep running toward the glow
Chasing highs I'll never know
[Chorus]
We are electric, we are gold
Stories that will never get old
